svg.text: c.1 is the A of ATG; bases before it are negative (c.−1 is the base just before; there is no c.0).

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Intronic bases count from the nearest exon edge: +N after an exon's last base, −N before the next exon's first.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: After the stop codon the count restarts with *: c.*1 is the first 3' UTR base.
